definition: A contract's price less its reference: future less cash index, falling to zero at expiry; perpetual less index, held near zero by funding.
boundaries: Annualise it to compare contracts with different expiries. A perp's basis never expires.
recognition: A wide positive basis on an index future reads as rich carry.

class_meanings.fx: Forward points against spot, a rate differential (not assessed further).
class_meanings.index_cfd: Only through the future the CFD prices from; a proxy.
class_meanings.commodity_cfd: Storage and supply between the CFD's future and spot (not assessed).
class_meanings.future: Future less cash, from rates less dividends, falling to zero at expiry.
class_meanings.perp: Perp less index, held near zero by funding, never expiring.

sources.quote: may be positive or negative, depending on dividend income and financing cost rates
Perps: perp minus index, held near zero by funding, never expires.
